sar.narrative: On 2016-11-22, fraud monitoring detected unauthorized transaction activity on card C13487-K1 belonging to customer C13487. The total unauthorized exposure is $74.96 USD across 1 transaction(s) (3478561) conforming to the 'account_takeover' fraud typology. The activity was executed through eCommerce channels utilizing device profile 'SM-G935F Build/NRD90M' and email domain 'yahoo.com'. Cardholder outreach was conducted pursuant to Bank Fraud Policy, and the cardholder confirmed that the transactions were unauthorized. Graph neighborhood analysis identified infrastructure connections linking this incident to 15 additional card(s) sharing identical device infrastructure. The bank took immediate protective action by placing a block on card C13487-K1 and placing all connected cards under heightened monitoring. This report is filed pursuant to regulatory requirements due to confirmed unauthorized compromise and shared device infrastructure.
